notes.title: UPDATE AND SALE
notes.notes:
During the year I tried to listen to the players and make changes in time. Sorry if there were delays and I missed something. This is the latest update this year.

Next year you will find many new good games! In the meantime, you can purchase Spaceship Looter with a 70% discount!

UPDATE:

- Minor bugs fixed

notes.title: VERY IMPORTANT UPDATE
notes.notes:
I get a lot of complaints from the players that you can not dodge bullets when you're in the corner. To whom this creates fun, and someone is experiencing difficulty. In order for the enemies and the player to have equal rights, I added evasion during the jump. Now if the player is in a jump, then the bullets bounce off him.

I hope you appreciate this important update and if necessary, change the review about the game. Thank you!

notes.title: UPDATE
notes.notes:
+ Increased the lifetime of crystals 5 times.
+ The life time of coins is increased 3 times.
+ Improved key generation. Now you will rarely return to the closed boxes.

Soon I'll add full support for the PS4 gamepad.

Thank you for reporting errors!

Have fan!

notes.title: UPDATE 10
notes.notes:
- Resurrection now costs 50 crystals. Freebie has ended =)
- Added control for lefties. I'm sorry that I did not do it right away. If something seems uncomfortable, tell me.
[code]
I, J, K, L - motion
U - action / cast
P - map
O - active item
Y - recharge
SPACE - jump
[/code]

Thank you for not forgetting to write positive reviews!

notes.notes:

notes.notes:

 In the additional menu appeared button to exit the game.
 After passing the training the player appears near the teleport.
 Added the ending in the form of thanks from the boss of the pub.
 Changed the weapon description in the map menu.
 New Arena mode, which opens after collecting all collector's artifacts.
 Leaderboards in arena mode.

 On a pirate frigate now can not be resurrected.
 New GUI

[/ List]

Bug Fixes[/ b]

 The frame in the hero selection menu no longer overlaps the medal.
 On some computers, the game worked at a speed of 120 fps (fixed, but there is no way to check).
 Active ability "Circular Shot" on the laser now works correctly.
 Shells falling from above, did damage even if the hero had invulnerability.
 Shells falling from above, did damage even if the hero was standing in a protective field.
 Mimic, sometimes hooked on the walls
 In the pause menu, you could recharge weapons, use skills and open a card.
 The enemies now do not fire when the pause is turned on or you are killed.
 When freezing the pirates froze only a cannon.
 Fixed some sounds.
 Sometimes there was an error in the main menu.
[/ List]

Friends, thank you for your patience! I spent 2 weeks working on this update and the new Arena regime. I hope you will enjoy!

notes.title: One month in release
notes.notes:
Greetings to friends!

Today is exactly a month since the release of Spaceship Looter and I would like to sum up some results.

First, based on positive feedback, I see that people like the game. Yes, there are drawbacks in it, but in general it was warmly received. If you still have not left your feedback, then it's time to do it and support the project.

Secondly, the weight feedback has allowed to make many improvements to the game. For a month I released 7 updates and some players even began to anticipate every Thursday to see what's new in the game. However, this Thursday I'm sensitive, disappointed, but it's just to make major changes that do not fit in one week.
Thirdly, despite the fact that everything is so rosy, it seems to me that the game is afraid to buy. I see 3 main reasons:
- Do not want early access.
- Not satisfied with the price.
- Few content.

It is in this order. Why am I making this conclusion? About 4 thousand people have added the game to the wishlist, i.e. She was interested in them, but they are not ready to buy it at the moment. Why? Afraid of early access? Waiting for positive feedback? Or is not satisfied with the price? Share in the comments, why did not you personally buy Spaceship Looter?

Let's see how the way out from early access (planned in June-July) and sales will show itself.

In the meantime, we are working on and looking forward with hope, expecting big changes!

Thank you all for your support!
